project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to be a user interface for an examination system, handling exam submissions, results, and user profiles. The codebase is structured around several Vue components, suggesting a modular design. Key features include exam form processing, result presentation, and user-specific data management. The project leverages routing to navigate between these distinct modules.

layers.description: Responsible for rendering the user interface and handling user interactions.
Contains supporting components and logic for the application.

macro_trends.title: High-Level Vue Import Risks
macro_trends.description: Several low-level Vue components (e.g., uploadFile, uploadProgessFile) are imported directly into higher-level components (e.g., ApplicationServices, ResultPage). This creates a potential vulnerability to state management issues and increases coupling, introducing fragility.

macro_trends.title: Potential State Management Concerns
macro_trends.description: The routing dependencies suggest a reliance on the Vue Router for navigation, but without a central state management solution (e.g., Vuex), the application is vulnerable to inconsistencies and difficult debugging. Component dependencies, like iLikeCoursesNew to iLikeCourses and iLikeCourses to iLikeLanding, require deep investigation.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission and Result Processing
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves a user submitting an exam form (ExamFormSubmission), which updates the system's state and triggers the generation of results (ResultPage). The workflow relies on Router navigation and potential data transfer between the components involved. The dependency chain between ExamFormSubmission, ResultPage and Transactions highlights potential bottleneck and complexity.
